# Vendored browser dependencies

These files are served from the same GitHub Pages site and loaded only when needed.

- PDF.js 6.2.108 (`legacy/build/pdf.mjs` and `pdf.worker.mjs`) — Apache-2.0
- PDF-Lib 1.17.1 (`dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js`) — MIT
- pinyin-pro 3.26.0 (`dist/index.js`) — MIT

The corresponding license files are stored beside each dependency. Update versions deliberately and regression-test PDF viewing, zooming, merging, and pinyin search before deployment.
